title: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 — Section 14 (Currency of licences to drive motor vehicles)
publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice
note: Defines licence validity duration, renewal eligibility windows, and validity conditions.

title: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 — Section 15 (Renewal of driving licences)
publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice
note: Prescribes application timing (within one year before or after expiry), grace periods, and re-test requirements after one year.

title: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 — Section 47 (Assignment of new registration mark on removal to another State)
publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice
note: Requires applying for a new registration mark (Form 27) when a motor vehicle is kept in another state for a period exceeding 12 months.

title: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 — Section 48 (No objection certificate)
publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice
note: Governs issuance of No Objection Certificate (Form 28) from the parent registering authority.

title: Motor Vehicles Act 1988 — Section 49 (Change of residence or place of business)
publisher: Legislative Department, Ministry of Law and Justice
note: Requires intimation of change of residence within 30 days to the registering authority in whose jurisdiction the owner now resides.

title: Central Motor Vehicles Rules 1989 — Rule 81 (Fees Schedule)
publisher: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
note: Table of statutory fees for driving licence renewal, smart card issuance, Form 27 assignment, Form 28 NOC, and hypothecation endorsement/cancellation.

title: MoRTH Notification G.S.R. 594(E) — Bharat (BH) Series Registration
publisher: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (MoRTH)
note: Governs BH series vehicles which do not require transfer of registration or NOC on relocation across states.

title: Parivahan Sewa Portal (National Transport Services)
publisher: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways / NIC
note: National portal for unified Vahan and Sarathi services, citizen grievance lodging, and national e-challan clearing.

title: Sarathi Driving Licence Services Portal
note: Aadhaar contactless online DL renewal, address change, slot booking, and DL smart card status.

title: Vahan Vehicle Services Portal
note: Online NOC (Form 28) application, RC address intimation (Form 33), and Form 35 hypothecation termination.

title: Telangana Transport Department Portal
note: Citizen services, online challan clearance, and local RTO jurisdiction in Telangana.

title: Karnataka Transport Department Portal
note: RTO appointment slot scheduling, lifetime road tax schedules, and Form 27 re-registration procedures in Karnataka.

title: Maharashtra Motor Vehicles Department Portal
publisher: Motor Vehicles Department, Government of Maharashtra
note: Maharashtra RTO citizen services, address transfer, and tax compliance.

title: Tamil Nadu Transport and Road Safety Department Portal
publisher: Transport and Road Safety Department, Government of Tamil Nadu
note: Tamil Nadu vehicle and licence services, slot scheduling, and fee structures.

title: Delhi Transport Department Portal
publisher: Transport Department, Government of NCT of Delhi
note: Faceless services portal for NCT of Delhi, contactless licence and RC modifications.
